rationale_overall: This week's pool is overwhelmingly noise relative to the watchlist: India-Pakistan missile/conflict reporting (geopolitical event coverage, not tied to any investable ticker), SpaceX/Starbase and Starlink items (private company, no ticker), school/youth robotics competitions, a defunct Soviet spacecraft re-entry, and generic AI listicles/papal commentary. The one item with a real catalyst -- Constellation Energy (CEG) reorienting toward grid-connected AI data-center power deals -- is a legitimate nuclear/AI-adjacent signal worth tracking, but it is not clearly stronger than the four core AI-wave holdings already held (AAPL, GOOGL, MSFT, NVDA), and a swap requires displacing one of them without a comparably strong deterioration signal on any of those names. No genuine catalyst this week justifies forcing an add+remove pair, so the watchlist is held unchanged; CEG remains a candidate to revisit if its AI-power/nuclear catalyst strengthens.
